media.title: Leopold and Bronisław Mittmann — portrait, 1912
media.altText: Leopold Mittmann seated beside a piano with his brother Bronisław standing with a violin, 1912.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. The photograph was published without a photographer's credit in 1912; the applicable term for an anonymous work has expired in the European Union, and publication before 1 January 1931 places it in the public domain in the United States.
